fact: Chapter 3 is titled 'The Reality Of Supernatural Mentality'
Supernatural placement in the kingdom of God is a function of the operation of a supernatural mentality
In Daniel chapter five King Belshazzar saw a handwriting on the wall and called in the astrologers, Chaldeans and soothsayers to give the interpretation
None of Belshazzar's wise men could read the writing or make known to the king the interpretation of it
It was the queen who came in and told Belshazzar about Daniel
The queen said there is a man in the kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods, and that light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him
The queen recalled that King Nebuchadnezzar had made Daniel master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans and soothsayers
Daniel 5:11-12 lists what was found in Daniel: an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and showing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts
Daniel was the name the king Belshazzar gave him, per the quoted text 'the same Daniel, whom the king named Belshazzar'
The queen knew the source of the operation of this supernatural mentality in Daniel, and knew that it was not natural
Daniel 5:14 records the king telling Daniel 'I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee'
After Daniel gave the interpretation, Daniel 5:29 records that they clothed him with scarlet, put a chain of gold about his neck, and proclaimed that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom
1 Corinthians 4:20 tells us the kingdom of God is not just in words but in power and demonstration of the Spirit of God
It takes being empowered to be a bonafide citizen of the kingdom, and your citizenship is validated by empowerment
Empowerment is a noun from the word empower, which means to invest with power, especially legal power or official authority
John 1:12 is cited again here: as many as received Jesus, to them He gave power to become, manifest and operate as sons of God
Empowerment is a requirement for you to earn your placement in the kingdom, and without power you do not have a place in the kingdom
The Holy Spirit is the principal source of divine empowerment

Acts 1:8 is quoted: 'But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth'
The Spirit of God is our covenant instrument for supernatural empowerment, and He was at work in Joseph, Daniel and Peter, who all operated above the natural sphere
Supernatural empowerment is to enable you to fully represent Jesus, witnessing to the reality of His resurrection and representing His kingdom with colour, beauty, power and authority
Luke 24:49 is quoted: 'And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high'
Until you are empowered, your place is not guaranteed
Empowerment by the Holy Spirit impacts the three realms of a man: his spirit, his soul (where his mind is located) and his body
He energizes you for supernatural feats such as healings, deliverances, casting out devils and taking your place in the realm of the spirit

Isaiah 61:1-3 is quoted, including beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD
The Holy Spirit makes you take your place in the world of the spirit by empowering your spirit man for dominion
Isaiah 11 describes the seven-dimensional ministry of the Holy Spirit, and among other things He will make you of quick understanding
His empowerment affects the soul positively: He quickens your mentality and empowers your mental faculty for supernatural exploits
If you carry the fresh oil of the Holy Spirit you enjoy fresh health, and every truly anointed person enjoys fresh health: the fresher the oil, the healthier you live
The engine oil analogy: when you change the engine oil in your car the engine comes alive afresh and the sound becomes more comely and satisfactory
Ephesians 4:4 is cited for there being one Spirit, and the same Spirit that raised Christ from the dead is the One that quickens your mortal body
Empowerment is not limited to only one realm; it covers all the realms of your existence
Mental empowerment will guarantee you supernatural placement on this earth
When the Holy Ghost came upon Peter he was transformed into another man, and his delivery in Acts 2 on the day of Pentecost could not have been that of an ignorant and unlearned man
Peter stood up and delivered a message he had not made any preparations for, with absolute precision, with names and dates mentioned with unbelievable accuracy
In thirty minutes Peter had started a church, with 3,000 converts
Peter simply exploded in mental dignity through a definite mental empowerment by the Holy Ghost
The Holy Ghost is the Spirit of excellence, and He is the One called the excellent spirit that indwelled Daniel, cited as Daniel 6:3
The Holy Ghost is the spirit of wisdom, counsel, knowledge and understanding, everything that makes for mental prowess, dignity and excellence
Luke 11:13 is quoted: 'If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?'
Isaiah 55:1 invites everyone that thirsts to come and freely drink of the water of life, and John 7:37-39 makes us understand that the Holy Spirit is the One being referred to
The Holy Spirit distinguished Peter, the ignorant and unlearned fisherman, such that he became a celebrity in his generation
The chapter closes urging the reader to approach the throne of grace for supernatural mental empowerment by a fresh release of the Holy Ghost, being determined for an encounter
